buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 4. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 1. The Service Provider/ Travel Agency should be registered with the appropriate government

department/authorities. The copies of registration document of the vehicles to be provided should be submitted along with the quotation. An Office of the Service Provider/ Travel Age ncy must be within West Bengal (Documentary evidence to be submitted at the time of sub mission of this bid). 2. The contract will be initially for a period of 01 (one) year and vehicle should be stayed at of fice premises 24*7. 3. Inspection of Vehicle: The designated vehicles and drivers, which were approved after inspection of vehicles at the time of awarding the contract, would only be put into operation and any changes in vehicle/driver will be allowed only with th e consent of the department. 4. The vehicle services will be provided in the Office of Circle-V, Durgapur Audit Commissione rate situated at 2nd floor, Aarav’s Baghajatin Road, Baghajatin Park, Siliguri- 734001 and wi ll be required for deployment within the jurisdiction of West Bengal and the vehicle should be registered in West Bengal State. 5. All expenses/charges of the driver, oil, fuel (Petrol/Diesel/CNG), insurance, taxes, repairs, T oll taxes and maintenance etc., of the vehicle, by whatever name called will be borne by th e Service Provider/ Travel Agency and this will override any clauses mentioned in GeM Bid Document or Contract Document. 6. The Bid estimated value will inclusive of all taxes. 7. The monthly bill will be submitted for the hire charges for distance of 2,000 Kms on or befo re the next month and payment will be made accordingly. 8. The duty hours for the driver and vehicle and will be normally from 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM all days. In case of emergency, driver can be retained for 24 hours duty. 9. In case of accident /fine due to violation of traffic rules, all the claims arising shall be met b y the Service Provider/ Travel Agency only. 10. In case of service not provided on any day(s) for any reason, the monthly charges shall be paid after deducting the amount for the number of day(s) service not provided on pro-rata basis. 11. In case of any CNG vehicle(s) provided by the travel agency, petrol/diesel vehicles may be provided in lieu of CNG vehicle(s) for outstation duties. 12. Outstation Night Charges will not be applicable. 13. The driver should be well mannered, experienced, well uniformed and must carry a mobile phone (at the cost of the seller). The driver should pose a valid driving license for LMV. 14. The driver and the vehicle must comply with all the provisions of the Motor Vehicle Act and other relevant laws. His services will be subject to satisfaction of the controlling officer. 15. The vehicle hire agreement can be terminated by either party after serving 30 days advan ce notice on the other party. 16. For the purpose of calculating the hire charges payable, log book shall be provided along with vehicle. Form of log book will be the same as maintained by the Central Government department for their official vehicle. The log book shall be maintained and it should be verif ied on monthly basis. After the completion of contract, the log book shall be deposited to t

he office/buyer. 17. No request for enhancing the rate /rental amount per km due to hike in fuel price, insuran ce payment, rise in cost-of-living index etc. during the contract period will be allowed. 18. The office/buyer reserves the right to accept or reject any quotation without assigning any reason; the decision of the office/buyer is final. 19. The service provider/contractor shall be responsible for paying wages at the rates not less than the minimum wages as notified by the Appropriate Government. 20. The Service Provider shall nominate a coordinator/ Single Point of Contact (SPOC) who shal l be responsible for regular interaction with the Buyer Department so that optimal services of the persons deployed could be availed without any disruption. 21. The Bidder should not have been blacklisted or debarred by any Central/State Government /agency of Central/State Government/Public Sector Undertaking/Regulatory Authority of In dia at the time of submission of this bid. 22. The Government servant and his relative involved in bidding directly or indirectly shall not be considered / entertained.
